hooks.name: Backend: code review on changed Java
hooks.description: Targets entra-backend (Spring Boot). Fires when a Java file under entra-backend/ is saved. Asks the agent to review the saved file for correctness, bugs, security issues, and project conventions. PostFileSave matchers are tested against the FILE PATH, so this scoping is exact.

action.prompt:
A Java file under entra-backend/ was just saved. Perform a focused code review of ONLY that file (do not refactor unrelated code). This is a learning/tutorial repo, so favor clear, teaching-oriented feedback.

Review for:
1. Correctness & bugs: logic errors, null handling, incorrect Optional/stream usage, resource leaks, exception handling, off-by-one and edge cases.
2. Security: never trust client input; validate with @Valid/Jakarta constraints; enforce authorization via @PreAuthorize/hasRole on write paths; never log tokens, secrets, or full JWTs; derive the caller identity from the token's oid/sub claim (not from request-supplied fields); avoid SQL injection (use JPA/parameter binding).
3. Spring/JPA conventions used in this project: constructor injection over field injection; DTOs (CreateItemRequest/UpdateItemRequest/ItemDto) at the web boundary rather than exposing entities; Flyway owns the schema (Hibernate ddl-auto=validate) so entities must match the migrated tables; keep controllers thin and push logic into services.
4. Style: the repo prizes explanatory comments. Flag missing or misleading comments on non-obvious security/auth logic.

Output a short, prioritized list (Critical / Should-fix / Nice-to-have). If the file looks good, say so briefly. Do not edit files unless the user asks you to.
